faq.question: What does Omari mean?
faq.answer: Omari is associated with the Arabic form عُمَرِي, whose core sense is omari; flourishing; from umar (swahili form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Omari?
faq.answer: Omari is associated with Arabic. Omari is the Swahili form of Arabic عُمَرِي, the relative form of عُمَر (ʿUmar).

faq.question: Is Omari an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form عُمَرِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Omari an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Omari can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Omari a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Omari should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUmar is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Omari mean in Urdu?
faq.answer: In Urdu, Omari is rendered عمری and carries the sense عمری، عمر سے منسوب.

faq.question: What does Omari mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Omari is rendered عمری and carries the sense عمری، منسوب به عمر.

faq.question: How is Omari pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is o-ma-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Omari?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Omari, omari. Script forms are عمري, عمری, عُمَرِي, उमरी.

faq.question: Is Omari a boy's or girl's name?
faq.answer: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
